IBM published a Statement of Direction for a product called IBM Z Atlas. 

The document describes Z Atlas as an AI-native solution that grounds AI skills and agents in key workflows. 

The tool intends to map a client's entire z/OS stack across infrastructure middleware and applications. 

IBM states that Z Atlas intends to eliminate the leading cause of unplanned z/OS outages. 

The design keeps experts in control and gives operations and development practitioners shared Z system visibility. 

IBM intends for AI-assisted insights and recommendations to preserve human review and decision authority. 

IBM CEO Arvind Krishna said the current Z17 generation has outsold all others by $1 billion. 

The Statement of Direction was published on Tuesday 27 October 2026.
